name: M.P. Evans Group PLC
research_rationale: Sep-2026 interim record H1 earnings and net-cash balance sheet still anchor the case; refreshed TTM OCF aligns with the strong-buy screen, while routine buybacks add little new operating detail.

weekly_updates.summary:
Oct–Nov RNS is routine “transaction in own shares” under the extended £3m cancellation programme (to 15 Dec 2026); prices cited up to ~1,828p.
No interim, trading or annual disclosures since 14 Sep 2026 interim results—the substantive filing set is unchanged.
News is buyback headlines and third-party El Niño / Indonesia export commentary; screen cash inputs show TTM OCF US$149.3m and FCF US$124.5m.
